name.value: Tallheo Hot Springs - No Name Creek Conservancy

description.value: Hot Springs-No Name Creek Conservancy is a remote BC Parks wilderness conservancy on the west side of South Bentinck Arm, encompassing two coastal watersheds with steep valleys. The area is best known for Talheo Hot Springs and is home to grizzly bears and mountain goats in largely undisturbed habitat. It holds high cultural importance to local First Nations and was established as part of the Central Coast land use planning process.

raw_osm.name: Tallheo Hot Springs - No Name Creek Conservancy

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is a remote wilderness conservancy on the west side of South Bentinck Arm, approximately 20km southwest of Bella Coola, accessible primarily by water. The website mentions Talheo Hot Springs and hunting as activities but lists no visitor infrastructure (no washrooms, water, bike facilities, or amenities). The OSM name uses 'Tallheo' while the BC Parks website body text spells it 'Talheo', and the park's official name on the website is 'Hot Springs-No Name Creek Conservancy' rather than the OSM name.
concerns: OSM name spells 'Tallheo' but BC Parks website body text uses 'Talheo'; official BC Parks park name is 'Hot Springs-No Name Creek Conservancy', not matching the OSM name.
Location is on the west side of South Bentinck Arm — water access only, no apparent road or cycling access.
No visitor amenities (washrooms, water, bike facilities) documented anywhere on the BC Parks page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a remote wilderness conservancy situated on the west side of South Bentinck Arm with no road access — reaching it requires water travel. It has no documented visitor infrastructure relevant to cycling tourism, and is not a practical destination for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The hot springs themselves may be of interest to multi-modal cycle-tourers operating out of Bella Coola, but the lack of road access and absence of any cycling infrastructure makes this a poor fit for the WWC directory.

wow_evidence: Natural coastal hot springs in a wilderness conservancy — a soak is day-shaping for riders; boat access from Bella Coola (access friction stays downstream).
blurb: Wilderness conservancy on South Bentinck Arm known for Tallheo Hot Springs.
